name: Road Wardens
short_role: Delay a fast breakthrough and finish it before contact.
question: Which approach needs one more tick to become defensible?
strength: A ground control unit and adjacent route obstacle turn one early charge into a readable interception window.
weakness: The obstacle deals no damage, the guard is ground-only, and neither answer covers armor or distant upper pressure.
choice: Spend two ground footprints to buy exactly one tick against breakthrough momentum.
